definitions.assignment_jaccard: Intersection / union of associated original IDs.
definitions.common_pair_f1: F1 of within-track unordered observation pairs, restricted to observations assigned by both methods. Labels include RX/channel. Numeric track IDs are never compared directly; unassociated is not a cluster.
definitions.prediction_difference: Model CFO difference on shared observations, modulo the alias period. Equal to residual_b - residual_a; each residual is within 450 Hz, so no additional wrapping is needed.
definitions.support: Same full-data residual policy as the selected tuning reports. Agreement does not establish physical identity or correctness.
